items.title: 🔴 Brazil presidential election heads to runoff with Bolsonaro ahead of Lula
Brazil presidential election heads to runoff as Bolsonaro leads Lula
items.summary: Brazilians voted Sunday in a high-stakes presidential election pitting incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro amid a regional shift to the right. Bolsonaro is the son of jailed former president Jair Bolsonaro. A runoff will take place October 25 if no candidate wins an outright majority.
